request.title: Current Question
request.description: User submits a question through the browser UI.
request.detail: CopilotKit sends the question and thread ID through HTTP/AG-UI to the AI Coordinator. The coordinator restores available conversation state, plans the work and selects the required tools and model route. An existing UUID continues the same conversation.

request.title: Grounding
request.description: Coordination initiates an automatic knowledge search.
request.detail: The AI Coordinator calls Retrieval MCP for grounding. Retrieval owns query encoding through shared BGE, searches the matching Qdrant index using dense and lexical signals, and reads prepared source text. Knowledge stays outside the context window until relevant evidence is needed.

request.title: Bounded Reasoning
request.description: Agent reads documents and generates an answer.
request.detail: Within bounded retrieval and logical model-call budgets, the coordinator can delegate focused work and request supporting source reads. It combines returned results with the evidence to produce a supported answer or identify a gap.

request.title: Plain Answer
request.description: The AI coordinator returns a concise answer without internal IDs.
request.detail: The generated answer omits citation cards and internal IDs, providing a direct response. If a requested word cap is missed, a no-tool repair may be used within the model allowance.

request.title: Checkpoint Continuation
request.description: Conversation state is saved to PostgreSQL.
request.detail: The official LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpointer stores the turn state using stable thread identifiers. Browser history and checkpoints remain separate stores; persistence does not prove exactly-once effects.

ingestion.title: Backup
ingestion.description: Save state before changing the active release.
ingestion.detail: The operator takes Qdrant and PostgreSQL backups and saves the matching prepared-document bundle and configuration. Backups do not change the activation mechanism.

ingestion.title: Convert and Prepare
ingestion.description: Extract text and create deterministic chunks.
ingestion.detail: Docling extracts supported binary documents while direct readers handle text. Deterministic preparation preserves original bytes and headings, creating document content hashes and chunks with stable identities without LLM summaries.

ingestion.title: Embed
ingestion.description: Generate vectors using the shared BGE service.
ingestion.detail: Prepared chunks are encoded by the shared BGE service with pinned model metadata. Batch load is bounded to preserve interactive capacity, producing vectors and job-embed.json.

ingestion.title: Assemble
ingestion.description: Combine retained knowledge with new delta documents.
ingestion.detail: To add documents without losing retained knowledge, prepare and embed a delta first. Assembly merges the immutable complete base with the delta into a new self-contained bundle.

source.heading: Add documents while retaining an existing bundle

ingestion.title: Import
ingestion.description: Verify and load the embedded bundle into Qdrant.
ingestion.detail: Import independently verifies point identity and counts against the matching document manifest. It creates a fresh Qdrant collection and job-import.json; interrupted-run recovery remains unverified.

ingestion.title: Activate and Verify
ingestion.description: Switch the active release and check answers.
ingestion.detail: The operator explicitly activates the verified Retrieval release selection. Finally, check answers and conversation reload before accepting the update. A failed check leaves the update incomplete.
